Asian Stocks Fall Ahead of US Bank Earnings Amid AI Concerns

Asian stock markets experienced a significant decline as investors awaited the release of third-quarter earnings reports from major US banks, including Bank of America. The downturn was partly attributed to anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) and a surge in bond yields, which impacted bank stocks, pushing them into a correction. Bank of America's Q3 earnings report was a key focus for the market.
